name: 787-logprobdecode-llama3-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct, bf16, ~16 GB of weights. An ungated re-upload of meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct with the same weights; the Meta Llama 3 Community License applies.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup the first 15%, bounded at 640 requests with a 3600 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, over `/v1/completions`, non-streaming. Prompts 256 +- 32 tokens (clamped 192-384), generations 512 +- 64 (clamped 384-640), output length pinned by `ignore_eos`. Every request body carries `temperature: 0` and `logprobs: 5` -- on this route an INTEGER top-k count, i.e. the five most likely tokens with their log-probabilities at every position. Seed 42.
purpose: A text completion service returning top-five token probabilities on an 8B model, 64 concurrent medium-length requests, single GPU.
launch:
# sglang at commit bcb6611a46cf5380e27bc05e7ac4945c3bd57ca8 (`git describe --tags` =
# v0.2.6-6-gbcb6611a46c). A commit, not a release, so the interpreter is named by
# `configs/env.yaml: venv`.
#
# 0.2.6-era ServerArgs: an unknown key is rejected at construction, so do not add keys from a
# later sglang (there is no `chunked_prefill_size` at this version, for instance).

# NousResearch's re-upload rather than `meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct`, which is gated.
model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1

# The longest draw is 384 prompt + 640 output = 1024 tokens, so no request is truncated.
context-length: 2048

# Both of these are MEMORY bounds and not part of the operating point: asking for
# log-probabilities materialises a `[tokens_in_the_forward, 128256]` float32 tensor outside the
# static pool, which at the engine's 16384-token prefill default would be 8.4 GB in one
# allocation beside ~16 GB of weights. Prompts are 192-384 tokens, so a 2048-token prefill batch
# is still 5 to 10 whole requests and no prompt is ever split.
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
max-prefill-tokens: 2048

random-seed: 42
